description: One row of ``custom_materials.csv``. Team data (EPD values), not course data.

assembly.description: Course assembly ('LCA Data' B / 'Lists'): Foundation, Interior Wall, Exterior Wall, Floor, Roof, Window, Columns, Beams, MEP, Energy, Misc (Column / Beam are accepted for Columns / Beams).
assembly.title: Assembly

material_type.description: New material name ending with its unit in brackets, like the course names ('LCA Data' C), e.g. 'Bamboo Beam (kg)'. Must not be a course catalog name.
material_type.title: Material Type

embodied_gwp_kgco2e.description: Embodied GWP (kgCO2e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' D). Must equal materials + transport + construction.
embodied_gwp_kgco2e.title: Embodied Gwp Kgco2E

embodied_energy_mj.description: Embodied energy (MJ) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' E). Must equal materials + transport + construction.
embodied_energy_mj.title: Embodied Energy Mj

embodied_water_kg.description: Embodied water (kg) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' F). Must equal materials + transport + construction.
embodied_water_kg.title: Embodied Water Kg

embodied_odp_kgcfc11e.description: Embodied ODP (kgCFC11e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' G). Must equal materials + transport + construction.
embodied_odp_kgcfc11e.title: Embodied Odp Kgcfc11E

materials_gwp_kgco2e.description: Materials GWP (kgCO2e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' H).
materials_gwp_kgco2e.title: Materials Gwp Kgco2E

materials_energy_mj.description: Materials energy (MJ) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' I).
materials_energy_mj.title: Materials Energy Mj

materials_water_kg.description: Materials water (kg) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' J).
materials_water_kg.title: Materials Water Kg

materials_odp_kgcfc11e.description: Materials ODP (kgCFC11e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' K).
materials_odp_kgcfc11e.title: Materials Odp Kgcfc11E

transport_gwp_kgco2e.description: Transport GWP (kgCO2e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' L).
transport_gwp_kgco2e.title: Transport Gwp Kgco2E

transport_energy_mj.description: Transport energy (MJ) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' M).
transport_energy_mj.title: Transport Energy Mj

transport_water_kg.description: Transport water (kg) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' N).
transport_water_kg.title: Transport Water Kg

transport_odp_kgcfc11e.description: Transport ODP (kgCFC11e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' O).
transport_odp_kgcfc11e.title: Transport Odp Kgcfc11E

construction_gwp_kgco2e.description: Construction GWP (kgCO2e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' P).
construction_gwp_kgco2e.title: Construction Gwp Kgco2E

construction_energy_mj.description: Construction energy (MJ) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' Q).
construction_energy_mj.title: Construction Energy Mj

construction_water_kg.description: Construction water (kg) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' R).

construction_odp_kgcfc11e.description: Construction ODP (kgCFC11e) per unit of material_type ('LCA Data' S).
construction_odp_kgcfc11e.title: Construction Odp Kgcfc11E

life_units.description: Course 'Life Units No.' ('LCA Data' T): unit multiplier over the building life (1 = no replacement).
life_units.title: Life Units

source.description: EPD reference: document, registration number, page, declared unit and how the values were converted to the unit of material_type.
source.title: Source

is_course_data.description: Always false: custom materials are team data.
is_course_data.title: Is Course Data

title: custom_materials.csv row
x-csv-notes: One CSV row per material, header row with these column names (order free). Lines starting with '#' are comments. Columns mirror a course 'LCA Data' row (B-T) plus source and is_course_data. Values per unit of material_type. material_type must not be a course catalog name. See docs/engines/stv.md.
